channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Desenrola 2 terá juros menores para quebrar ciclo da dívida
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that Desenrola 2 will require banks to offer significantly lower interest rates, especially on credit card, personal loan, and overdraft debts, to break the cycle of unsustainable indebtedness affecting around 20% of Brazilian families. The program combines discounts with cheaper refinancing and is expected to launch this week after presidential approval, with no link to Copom decisions.

item.title: Dino suspende ação sobre crime eleitoral no MA e manda caso ao STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino issued a preliminary injunction suspending part of an electoral investigation in Maranhão concerning an alleged criminal organization that allegedly circumvented gender quotas. The decision followed references to federal deputy Josimar do Maranhãozinho (PL-MA), who has been convicted of electoral crimes, and ordered the case files to be sent to the Supreme Court for adjudication.

item.title: Os desafios do governo Lula nas eleições: segurança pública
item.description: Public security is a structural challenge for Lula’s government, as the left traditionally views violence as a systemic issue requiring more than police repression — including inequality reduction, education, job creation, and urban improvements. However, the lack of effective policies in recent years and rising insecurity have empowered far-right 'hardline' discourses, which exploit public desperation to promote authoritarian proposals like the 'Bukelization' of Brazil. Datafolha research shows violence is the country’s second-largest problem (19%), behind only health, increasing pressure on the government to deliver concrete and effective solutions.

item.title: Crusoé: “Wesley Safadão não quer que eu seja presidente”, diz Renan
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) claimed that singer Wesley Safadão does not want him to be elected president, after being sued by the artist for posting a recording criticizing publicly funded concerts in financially strained municipalities. Renan said Safadão 'lost it' after the video was shared.

item.title: Desenrola 2 terá desconto de até 90% em dívidas, diz ministro
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that Desenrola 2 will offer discounts of up to 90% on credit card, personal loan, and overdraft debts, with significantly reduced interest rates, targeting tens of millions of Brazilians. The program, to be presented to President Lula this week, includes limited FGTS withdrawals and financial education measures, and is described as an exceptional, non-recurring measure.

item.title: Izalci Lucas informa que PL votará contra indicação de Jorge Messias ao STF
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF) announced that the Liberal Party will vote against Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, stating Messias must explain his alleged mention by Dilma Rousseff in 2016 and his stance on the January 8 attacks. He also supported overturning President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill (PL 2.162/2023).

item.title: Vice será escolhido com foco em governabilidade, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that the vice-presidential pick for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential pre-candidacy will be chosen with a focus on governability and electoral victory. He denied that a name has already been selected and emphasized the decision will be made at the right time, noting that party conventions are scheduled for July.

item.title: PL rebate vídeo do PT que associa Flávio Bolsonaro ao caso Master: 'Não há qualquer investigação que envolva o senador'
item.description: The PL leadership in the Chamber of Deputies issued a statement defending Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after PT-linked materials associated him with the Banco Master scandal, asserting there is no investigation against him and denouncing an effort to construct an artificial narrative. The statement also references a meeting between Banco Master controller Daniel Vorcaro and President Lula, shifting the focus of criticism. This comes amid the PT’s communication strategy during its 8th National Congress, which also approved a manifesto proposing structural reforms, including in the judiciary and political system.

item.title: Lula deve anunciar novo programa de renegociação de dívidas nesta semana, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said President Lula will announce a new household debt renegotiation program this week, offering discounts of up to 90% and reduced interest rates. Brazilian household indebtedness reached a record 49.9%, according to central bank data released Monday. The government also plans to allow restricted use of FGTS funds to pay off debts under the program.

item.title: Sabatina na CCJ: o caminho de Messias no Senado para virar ministro do STF
item.description: Jorge Messias, nominated by Lula for the STF, will undergo a hearing in the Senate's CCJ on Wednesday (April 29). To be approved, he needs an absolute majority in the plenary (41 of 81 senators) after CCJ approval (14 of 27 votes). The process follows constitutional procedures for appointment as a Supreme Court Justice.

item.title: Gleisi quer tornar conselheiro de Trump ‘persona non grata’ após ofensas contra brasileiras
item.description: Federal Deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) introduced a bill to declare Paolo Zampolli, businessman and Trump’s special envoy for Global Affairs, as 'persona non grata' in Brazil, following his offensive remarks that Brazilian women are 'programmed to extort and cause chaos'. The proposal, grounded in Brazil’s Migration Law and principles of national sovereignty and human dignity, seeks to block his entry, stay, or official activities in the country.

item.title: Temer diz que Gilmar não deveria ter respondido a Zema: ‘Mais argumentos dá para contestação’
item.description: Former President Michel Temer criticized Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes for responding to criticisms from pre-candidate Romeu Zema, arguing that such replies only fuel further opposition to the Court. Temer attributed judicial polarization to the 1988 Constitution’s design, which brings political issues to the Supreme Court, and to a lack of dialogue among the branches of government. Zema has labeled ministers 'untouchables' and accused the STF of living in luxury while Brazilians suffer, following his inclusion in the fake news inquiry for sharing a satirical video about justices and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Governo vai liberar uso de FGTS em programa para brasileiros endividados, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced the government plans to allow FGTS funds to be used in a new program for indebted Brazilians, with restrictions on withdrawals tied to debt repayment. The initiative, still being structured, proposes up to 90% discounts on credit card, consumer direct credit (CDC), and overdraft debts, targeting those earning up to five minimum wages. Durigan will present the proposal to President Lula on Tuesday for a possible announcement later this week.

item.title: Deputado do PL aciona PGR contra o PT por vídeo que associa Flávio ao caso Master
item.description: Bolsonarist deputy Sanderson (PL-RS) has filed a complaint with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate alleged dissemination of fake news after the PT released a video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master case. The deputy claims the video has political-electoral intent and aims to damage the image of former President Jair Bolsonaro's son. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Sóstenes rebate associação de Flávio ao caso Master: “Distorção dos fatos”
item.description: Federal Deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante, leader of the PL in the Chamber, rebutted associations made between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the Banco Master case, labeling them as a 'recurring strategy of distortion of facts'. He emphasized that the accusations lack foundation and are part of a repetitive pattern of misinformation.

item.title: Em evento oficial do governo de SP, Tarcísio chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'próximo presidente' e senador promete 'cuidar do povo brasileiro'
item.description: At an official São Paulo government event at Agrishow 2026, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) the 'next president of Brazil,' while Flávio pledged to 'care for the Brazilian people,' pointed to changes starting in 2027, praised Jair Bolsonaro’s administration, and emphasized support for agribusiness.

item.title: Lula vai anunciar programa de renegociação de dívidas esta semana, diz Durigan; descontos chegarão a 90%
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan met with CEOs of major banks to finalize details of a federal government debt renegotiation program, to be announced by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by May 1st. The program will offer discounts of up to 90% on debts, with interest rates reduced to 1.99% per month, aiming to shift high-cost debts like credit card and consumer direct credit to cheaper lines such as payroll loans. The goal is to benefit tens of millions of indebted Brazilians by leveraging the financial system and the FGTS fund to facilitate renegotiation.

item.title: “Não vejo Lula nem Flávio ganhando a eleição”, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, states he does not see Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro winning the 2026 election due to high rejection rates (48% according to Nexus/BTG poll). He notes that although Lula and Flávio lead in polls with 41% and 36%-38% respectively, their high rejection makes victory unlikely. Kassab believes other pre-candidates, such as Ronaldo Caiado, currently perform poorly due to lack of national visibility but are expected to grow during the campaign.

item.title: Ministros do TSE avaliam que regras sobre IA nas eleições não são suficientes; caso 'Dona Maria' leva questão ao tribunal
item.description: TSE ministers deem current AI election rules insufficient for 2026, following a lawsuit by PT, PV and PCdoB against the 'Dona Maria' AI persona — a nearly 750k-follower Instagram account spreading decontextualized criticism of left-wing politicians without clear AI labeling. The case underscores monitoring challenges due to the accessibility and affordability of AI tools, with existing rules restricting oversight to content from parties and candidates, leaving out vast volumes of third-party AI-generated viral content.

item.title: Aliados do governo articulam troca de nomes na CCJ do Senado para favorecer aprovação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Government allies negotiated changes in the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) to secure a favorable majority for Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Court. The adjustments, made between Thursday and Friday last week, replaced opposing or undecided senators with allies, increasing government support to about 16 votes in the committee — two above the required 14. Despite the progress, the vote remains sensitive, with some members still refraining from public declarations.

item.title: Kassab defende que próximo presidente tenha ‘coragem’ para reforma do Judiciário
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, argued that the next president of Brazil must have the 'courage' to lead a judicial reform, emphasizing the need for adjustments in the functioning of the STF and greater legal transparency. He stated the issue should become central in the national political debate ahead of the 2026 elections, although he did not detail specific proposals. The remarks were made at a Lide Group event in São Paulo, amid intensifying pre-election discussions.

item.title: Kassab diz que PSD pediu saída de Ramuth da sigla, mas nega atrito
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that the party requested the exit of São Paulo's vice-governor, Felício Ramuth, from the party, denying any conflict with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas or Ramuth himself. He explained that Ramuth had been positioning himself independently, seeking to be vice 'on his own flight,' which made his continued presence in the PSD untenable. Kassab added that Ramuth's move to the MDB was facilitated by Tarcísio and that the PSD will support the governor's choice for vice in 2026, regardless of the name.

item.title: Governo investe R$ 75 mi em centros de saúde e veículos para o SUS
item.description: The Lula government inaugurated 5 radiotherapy centers with an investment of R$58.8 million and announced the distribution of 3,300 vehicles for patient transport, with R$16.4 million allocated, during a ceremony in Presidente Prudente (SP). The Ministry of Health allocated R$32.2 billion for SUS infrastructure, equipment, and vehicles nationwide, including 2,600 Basic Health Units, 330 Psychosocial Care Centers, and 4,800 SAMU ambulances. Vice President Geraldo Alckmin attended the ceremony alongside the Ministers of Health, Education, and Agrarian Development.

item.title: Quem mudar de posição sobre dosimetria terá que se explicar, diz coordenador de campanha de Flávio
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), leader of the opposition, reacted to the possibility that President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill would be upheld, stating that anyone who changes their position on the issue will have to explain themselves. The comment was made days before Congress convenes to review the presidential veto. The article was published on 04/27/2026 at 16:08.

item.title: MPF arquiva caso de xenofobia em SC, após Lula derrotar Bolsonaro nas eleições de 2022
item.description: The MPF archived an investigation into alleged xenophobia following the 2022 elections, in which Lula defeated Bolsonaro in SC. The case involved a social media post by Romeu DV questioning whether Northeasterners and Northerners should be expelled from Santa Catarina. Although deemed morally reprehensible, the MPF concluded there was no segregationalist intent or concrete violation of fundamental rights, in line with the STF’s restrictive interpretation of criminal hate speech.

item.title: ‘Cada um no seu tempo’: Flávio nega pressão por apoio de aliados à pré-candidatura
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he will not pressure allies to publicly support him on social media or at events, emphasizing that each person should show support in their own time and proportion. He noted observing growing willingness among supporters who want to see Brazil return to prosperity. Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) endorsed Flávio's pre-candidacy, saying he will be president 'one day' and that they will have an extensive agenda together in São Paulo.

item.title: Análise: pesquisa mostra como ‘efeito Ricardo Couto’ abala estratégia bolsonarista no RJ
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll reveals that the 'Ricardo Couto effect', stemming from his interim governorship, undermines the Bolsonarist strategy in Rio de Janeiro, contributing to Cláudio Castro's (PL) resignation ahead of a potential TSE ruling that could remove him from office. The survey shows how the leadership transition impacted voting intentions and cohesion within Bolsonaro's allied base.

item.title: Crusoé: Tarcísio publica foto de provável chapa em SP
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) posted a photo on social media showing the likely ticket that will accompany him in his 2026 re-election bid. Alongside him are Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and André do Prado (PL), president of the São Paulo Legislative Assembly. The image highlights the political alignment between the governor, the Bolsonarist faction, and PL allies in the state.

item.title: Desembargador ganha sobrevida no governo do Rio enquanto Dino prepara voto sobre sucessão
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino is preparing his vote on the case defining the format of the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial succession election, following the TSE ruling that made former Governor Cláudio Castro ineligible. Meanwhile, Justice Ricardo Couto of the Rio de Janeiro Court of Justice remains in an interim executive role. The STF is evaluating whether Castro’s resignation was a tactic to avoid removal and trigger an indirect election in the state legislature, where his party, the PL, holds a majority. The current vote count stands at 4 to 1 in favor of an indirect vote.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro diz que Flávio se apoia em quem 'oferece discursos ilusórios' e critica: 'Está mordendo a isca'
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized his brother Flávio for allegedly relying on advisors who offer 'illusory discourses,' saying he is 'biting the bait' too easily. He also defended the Bolsonarist group against accusations of opportunism, responding to Nikolas Ferreira’s criticism, and highlighted Romeu Zema’s support for Lula’s tax reform as a point of tension within the right-wing spectrum.

item.title: Crusoé: Castro lidera dois cenários ao Senado no Rio, aponta Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) leading in two of three simulated Senate race scenarios, followed by former governor Benedita da Silva (PT). In a third scenario, Castro is excluded due to ineligibility declared by the TSE, and the race is analyzed without him. The Rio Senate elections will take place in October 2026.

item.title: Desenrola 2.0: o que se sabe sobre o programa que promete desconto de até 90% em dívidas
item.description: The Lula government is preparing Desenrola 2.0, a debt renegotiation program for individuals earning up to five minimum wages, offering discounts of 20% to 90% on debts such as credit cards and overdrafts, financed by R$10 billion from the Treasury. The official announcement will be on May 1, 2026, aiming to improve financial health and economic perception, as 57% of Brazilians currently view the economic situation as bad.

item.title: Para oposição, crise no STF deve ajudar derrubada de veto do PL da Dosimetria
item.description: The opposition is mobilizing to overturn President Lula's full veto of the Dosimetria Bill, an alternative to the Amnesty Bill that would reduce sentences for those involved in the January 8, 2023, riots. They argue that the alleged credibility crisis facing the STF, particularly due to the Banco Master scandal, makes it easier to persuade centrist lawmakers that the penalties imposed by the Court are excessive. Congress President Davi Alcolumbre has scheduled a session to consider the veto for this Thursday.

item.title: Kassab: ‘Não vejo nem Lula nem Flávio ganhando a eleição’
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro are likely to win the 2026 election, advocating for his party's candidate, Ronaldo Caiado, as a change alternative. He attributed Lula's 2022 victory to Jair Bolsonaro's poor personal performance and acknowledged that, despite the negative outcomes of Bolsonaro's government, it had competent ministers. Kassab emphasized that Brazilian voters are tired of both Lulism and Bolsonarismo due to corruption scandals and sees room for alternative candidates to grow before the July conventions.

item.title: Kassab diz que presidente eleito precisa ter ‘coragem’ para ajustes, ‘inclusive no Judiciário’
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, said the next president needs 'courage' for institutional adjustments, including in the Judiciary, and dismissed the chances of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro winning the 2026 elections. He also rejected potential PT support in São Paulo, pledging unconditional support for Tarcísio de Freitas and Flávio Bolsonaro, and stated that the choice of Ronaldo Caiado's running mate will be decided from July onward.

item.title: Um bumerangue contra Zema
item.description: The dean of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Gilmar Mendes, received backing from supporters of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in his public criticism of former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema. Carlos Bolsonaro, former city councilor and son of the ex-president, intensified the tension with Zema in a social media post, signaling alignment between Bolsonarist circles and the STF justice against the mineiro politician. The episode reveals a rare alliance between Bolsonarista allies and the STF in opposition to Zema.

item.title: Eduardo tem “palavra final” sobre candidato a senador por SP, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that Eduardo Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro will have the 'final say' in choosing the second Senate candidate for São Paulo backed by the PL in the 2026 elections. It is already confirmed that the party will support federal deputy Carlos Henrique Vieira as the first name on the ticket. The final decision on the second candidate will be made by the two most influential Bolsonaros in the family.

item.title: Paulinho da Força declara apoio a eventual candidatura de Ciro Gomes
item.description: Paulinho da Força, president of Solidariedade, declared support for a possible presidential candidacy of Ciro Gomes, expressing interest in repeating the 2002 ticket with Aécio Neves. He views Ciro as the most authentic third-way alternative, criticizing other options for shifting to the right. Ciro is still deciding whether to run for president or for governor of Ceará, with a decision expected by early May.

item.title: Kassab defende reforma no Judiciário pelo próximo presidente
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, says Brazil’s next president must have the courage to reform the Judiciary and other sectors, citing pré-candidate Ronaldo Caiado as advocating for changes in political system, including STF minister selection criteria and a minimum age of 60. Minister Flávio Dino also supports a new Judiciary reform, grounded in public interest and technical consistency, referencing the Tax Reform as a model. Criticism of the STF has intensified after Bolsonaro’s conviction, with allegations of conflict of interest involving ministers like Dias Toffoli and Alexandre de Moraes tied to the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: O que será discutido na comissão especial sobre escala 6×1 nesta semana
item.description: The special committee on the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale will be installed this week, as promised by Chamber President Hugo Motta. Deputies will discuss the substance of proposals by Reginaldo Lopes (PT-MG) and Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP), which reduce the weekly workweek to 36 hours but with transition periods of ten and one year, respectively. Although the Lula government has introduced a more moderate bill (40 hours, 5×2), Motta is maintaining the PEC process due to legal security concerns, opening room for negotiations on workdays and hours.

item.title: Nesta semana, quatro legendas exibem propaganda partidária
item.description: This week, four political parties will broadcast partisan propaganda during prime time on radio and television, on Tuesday (28), Thursday (30), and Saturday (2). The PT will have three minutes split evenly across the three days; Cidadania, five minutes (2.5 minutes each on Tuesday and Thursday); Podemos, six and a half minutes (1.5 minutes Tuesday, 1 minute Thursday, 4 minutes Saturday); and União Brasil, only 30 seconds on Thursday. This broadcasting occurs in the first semester of 2026, an election year, as per the electoral calendar.

item.title: Caiado: ‘Qualquer um’ vence Lula no 2º turno, mas ‘PT volta se não souber governar’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential pre-candidate, stated that 'anyone' would defeat Lula in a runoff, but the PT would return to power in 2030 if the winner fails to govern effectively. He emphasized his record as former governor of Goiás, citing 88% approval, improvements in education and security, and criticized the PL for poor governance, positioning the PSD as an alternative to the worn-out PT and Bolsonaro factions.

item.title: Wesley Safadão processa Renan Santos por acusá-lo de ser 'novo ícone da corrupção'
item.description: Singer Wesley Safadão filed a criminal complaint against Renan Santos, the Missão party's pre-candidate for president, for defamation after Santos called him the 'new icon of corruption' on social media. The lawsuit aims to protect Safadão's reputation, and the full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Kassab diz que PSD ‘não tem pressa’ para escolher vice na chapa de Caiado
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab said the party is not in a rush to choose a vice-presidential candidate for Ronaldo Caiado’s ticket, with discussions scheduled for June. He emphasized the goal is to pick someone who can add votes and help Caiado govern, without confirming whether the ticket will be pure or in coalition. Kassab also defended Caiado’s Serra Verde rare earths deal as cooperation that attracts technology and investment, rejecting claims of surrender.

item.title: Carlos Bolsonaro critica reforma tributária e dá alerta a Flávio
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro criticized the Lula government's tax reform, warning it will increase taxes even before full implementation, and urged his brother Flávio Bolsonaro not to be swayed by illusory discourses. He said investors and contractors in Santa Catarina and across Brazil are deeply concerned about the reform's impact, which he labeled a 'transatlantic freighter of taxes'. Carlos also advocated for uniting the right to win in the first round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Kassab diz que Bolsonaro 'teve desempenho pessoal muito aquém das expectativas'
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro during a business lunch organized by Grupo Lide in São Paulo. He stated that Bolsonaro had a 'personal performance well below expectations' and emphasized that the PSD is 'doing its part,' despite former governor Ronaldo Caiado not advancing to the presidential runoff.

item.title: O apelo de Daniel Silveira a Moraes para voltar a usar redes sociais
item.description: Former federal deputy Daniel Silveira again requested STF authorization to access social media, but Minister Alexandre de Moraes referred the request to the PGR for a five-day opinion, after previously denying it. Silveira’s defense filed a regimental appeal, now under review. He also had denied a request to flexibilize his open regime schedule to study law at night, with Moraes stating restrictions do not block education access.

item.title: Kassab diz que PSD dá apoio “incondicional” a Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, reaffirmed the party's unconditional support for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) in his re-election bid in São Paulo, ruling out any alliance with the PT. He emphasized that the PSD was the first party to back Tarcísio and expressed satisfaction and active involvement in the campaign, despite recent developments such as the vice-governor Felício Ramuth switching to the MDB and Kassab's departure from the Governor's Office.

item.title: Flávio faz primeiro ato de pré-campanha com Tarcísio e diz que governador será presidente 'um dia'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, held his first pre-campaign event alongside São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), praising the governor's future potential to become president 'one day'. The meeting took place on Monday, April 27, 2026, and featured mutual compliments and pledges of unity between the two Bolsonarist leaders.

item.title: Lula cancela participação em compromissos públicos após procedimento cirúrgico
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) canceled his participation in two public commitments after undergoing a surgical procedure. He missed the Workers' Party congress and did not deliver the scheduled videoconference speech at a family farming event, as originally planned.
